title: Exact Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer Formula from Low Selmer Corank
main_claim: For every elliptic curve E/Q and any prime q with corank Sel_{q^infty}(E/Q) in {0,1}: analytic rank = MW rank = that corank, Sha is finite, and the full BSD leading-term formula holds exactly at every prime. The odd-primary part comes from X_p(E) >= 0 for non-CM curves (Kato-type integral determinant) plus X_p(E)+X_p(E^D)=0 (a unit anticyclotomic BDP/strict-Selmer comparison over K = Q(sqrt D)). The 2-part comes from companion [B], ranks from companion [C], and the CM rank-0 case from Burungale–Flach.
coverage:
Read in full: Introduction, Sec 2 (inputs, auxiliary fields, Gross–Zagier normalization, discrepancy identity), Sec 9 (unit comparison: quotient regularity, ideal equality, the augmented-alternating and tangent-minor codimension lemmas, simultaneous jumps, unit theorem), Sec 10 (central volume, CM rank-0 lemma, assembly). Also read Sec 3 lemmas haar, kummer-volume, series-division, poles, field-points; Sec 4 opening (auxiliary tuples, statement of residual concentration, scalar localization); Sec 5 through Prop 'Integral normalized coordinate'; Sec 6 through vertical primitivity (primitive, interpolation (10)-(12), trace lemma, descent); and the statement of the Sec 8 theta implication.

Checks I verified:
(a) Root-number and parity choices in Lemma auxiliary-fields, including the Jacobi symbol via D' ≡ -1 mod |D|, unramified L/F, and roots of unity.
(b) The Gross–Zagier index identity [E(K):Z P_K]^2 = c_E^2 prod c_l^2 #Sha(E/K) matches GZ Conj V.2.2. Factor-of-2 conventions only affect v_2.
(c) The Haar identity tau_l = v_p(c_l P_l(1)) for good, split, nonsplit and additive l ≠ p, including a direct Tate-curve torsion count. Also tau_p - l - e_p = v_p(c_p) for good, multiplicative and additive p, with the eq (12) Euler factor P_p. This makes Sec 10's cancellation give exactly the GZ-conjectural index.
(d) The p-depletion recursion f^{[p]} = (1 - a_p V + p eps V^2) f and d(P_p(V_p) G) = f^{[p]}.
(e) The commutative algebra in Lemmas augmented-alternating and tangent-minors: incidence dimension count, and initial-ideal height via the associated graded ring.
(f) Weierstrass-division uniqueness in the series-division lemma.
(g) The B/L factor bookkeeping when tame variables are removed.
(h) The CM rank-0 reduction to Burungale–Flach via Res_{M/Q} E_M ~ E^2.

Not verified line by line, because they are too compressed: the novel residual-concentration argument (rest of Sec 4), Sec 5 after the integral coordinate, Sec 6 vertical primitivity and high-character divisibility, and the theta-section, content and extraction arguments in Secs 7–8. A gap, if there is one, would most plausibly be in these parts, but I could not point to a specific failing step. Burungale–Flach's exact hypotheses and prime restrictions could not be checked offline. Only odd p is needed from them.
sibling_notes: The family-002 board was empty when I started. Afterwards it showed the rank-7 sibling (two-primary BSD companion [B]): no_gap_found on a partial audit, with the 2-adic Kato/Siegel sections also too compressed to verify. That bears on this paper only through Theorem classical:two-primary, which supplies positivity, rationality and v_2. I checked the dependency graph: [C] cites Goldfeld; Goldfeld mentions [B] and [C] only as subsequent consequences in its introduction. I found no circular dependency involving this paper.
